note: The blank range: unprinted containers Gifted with Purpose can print on. Every name, capacity, dimension and print area on this list was read from the supplier's own live product page at titanjet.co.za on 25 Aug 2026, matched to the SKU code printed on the photographs the client sent. Nothing here is estimated. No price appears on this list because no price for any of these nine has been confirmed by the client, so every one reads 'Price on request'. Supplier stock status is deliberately not published: that is the supplier's warehouse, not ours.

shapes.name: 12oz Stainless Steel Coffee Mug
shapes.wrap: full wrap around the body, handle left clear
shapes.blurb: A squat steel mug with a squared-off handle and a sliding lid, so a hot drink at a desk stays hot past the first meeting. The body is one clean white face with nothing on it.

shapes.name: 12oz Gin Tumbler
shapes.blurb: Short, round-shouldered and wide enough to hold in a whole hand. The print area is long and low, so this one suits a line of text running right around rather than a tall picture.

shapes.name: 15oz Skinny Tumbler
shapes.blurb: The in-between size. Taller than a mug, shorter than the 20oz, and it still drops into a car cup holder. Supplied by the maker as a set with a straw.

shapes.name: 20oz Skinny Tumbler
shapes.blurb: The tall one. Nearly the largest print area in the range, which is why most of the full-height artwork gets put on this shape. Supplied as a set with a straw.

shapes.name: 20oz Hot and Cold Skinny Tumbler
shapes.supplier_name: 20oz White Stainless Steel Hot and Cold Skinny Tumbler
shapes.blurb: Same tall body as the 20oz, but the lid flips open with a thumb instead of taking a straw. The one to pick if it is going to be carried and drunk from on the move.
shapes.supplier_note: The maker states this one ships with a plastic straw, not a metal one, and the straw must be pushed into the lid for the mouthpiece to work.

shapes.name: 250ml Can Tumbler
shapes.lid: Silver screw lid with a pull tab
shapes.blurb: Shaped like a soft drink can, ribbed shoulders and all, down to the ring pull on the lid. The smaller of the two cans and the one that reads most like a joke gift until you pick it up.

shapes.name: 400ml Can Tumbler
shapes.lid: Silver screw lid with a pull tab
shapes.blurb: The tall can. Same ring-pull lid as the 250ml but stretched, which gives the artwork a good deal more room without losing the cup holder fit.

shapes.name: 300ml Kids Flip-Top Bottle
shapes.supplier_name: 300ml Yellow Cap Stainless Steel Sippy Cup
shapes.colour: White body, yellow and blue cap
shapes.lid: Blue and yellow flip-top lid with a soft straw and a carry loop
shapes.blurb: School bag bottle. The button pops the straw up one-handed and the loop clips it to a bag. The cap is yellow and blue and stays that way, so the artwork has to live on the white body underneath.

shapes.supplier_sku_note: The photograph is labelled SB893 F. The supplier's own product page lists the code as SP893 for the same item.
shapes.name: 320ml Baby Sippy Cup
shapes.supplier_name: 320ml White Stainless Steel Straight Baby Sippy Cup
shapes.colour: White body, clear handles and spout
shapes.lid: Clear sippy spout lid with two clip-on handles
shapes.blurb: Two clear handles either side and a soft spout on top, sized for hands that are still learning. Straight-sided, so a wrap sits flat all the way round with no stretching.
